description:
[read-only] Engagement overview for the last 7, 30 or 90 days. Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/analytics.)

experimentId.description: FFE-1204: one experiment's per-variant results instead of brand totals: the same body as `GET /api/v2/experiments/{id}/results` (incl. % watched per arm; unreported watch data is `null`, never 0).

groupBy.description: A label key (e.g. `cut`, `variant`). Returns the per-label / per-experiment breakdown instead of brand totals: the same body as `GET /api/v2/analytics/experiments?key=<groupBy>` (which also takes `window`, `metric`, `brandId`, `format`, `include`).

labelKey.description: FFE-1204: alias of `groupBy`. Use at most one of `groupBy`, `labelKey`, `experimentId` (two → 422).

title: Analytics overview
